spans.s:
कुठ कुठ, अस्, m. a tree; (generally written
कुट.)

कुठर कुठर, अस्, m. the post round which
the string of the churning-stick winds; [cf. कुटर.]

कुठार कुठार, अस्, ई, m. f. an axe; a sort
of hoe or spade; (अस्), m. a tree; N. of a man.

कुठाकु कुठाकु, उस्, m. a bird, the wood-
pecker, Picus Bengalensis, commonly Kāṭhṭhākro.
कुठाटङ्क कुठाटङ्क, अस्, आ, m. f. an axe.

कुठारक, अस्, m. an axe; (इका), f. a small axe
or adze; also a similarly shaped instrument used in
surgery for scarification; N. of a woman.

कुठारु कुठारु, उस्, m. an ape, a monkey;
a tree; an armourer.

कुठि कुठि, इस्, m. a tree; a mountain;
[cf. कुटि.]

कुठिक कुठिक, अस्, m., N. of a plant, =
कुष्ठ, मृत्फली, a kind of Costus, commonly
called Kuṭh.

कुठुमि कुठुमि, इस्, m., N. of a preceptor,
author of a law-book; [cf. कुथुमि.]

कुठेर कुठेर, अस्, m. fire; a kind of Basi-
licum.
—कुठेर-ज, अस्, m. a white kind of Basi-
licum, Ocimum Gratissimum.

कुठेरक, अस्, m. a kind of Basilicum, Ocimum
Sanctum; a white sort of the same, Ocimum Gra-
tissimum.

कुठेरु कुठेरु, उस्, m. the wind produced
by a fan or chowrie.
